message: Two candidate answers undergo the same check. Both fail. Instead of selecting a winner, the assistant sends the answers to a person for review.
audience: People learning how AI answer checking and human review can work
claims: Two candidate answers receive the same check.
The assistant sends both answers to a person for review.
illustrative_assumptions: The check is staged as an identical tactile link stencil revealing route gaps.
The answers are labeled A and B.
An arena setting visually represents comparison and review.
ending_action: Both failed answer sheets finish moving into a separate person's hand and remain there for review, with no winner shown.

beats.subject: Both candidate answers
beats.action: The two answer sheets arrive side by side while the bot presents the shared test.
beats.before_after: Before: no candidates are visible. After: A and B are aligned together, both untested.
beats.focal_detail: Matching answer sheets positioned under one stencil-check setup.
beats.consequence: The comparison begins under equal conditions.
beats.narration: Two answers face the same route check.
beats.caption: One shared check
beats.headline: Same test

beats.subject: Answer A
beats.action: The stencil lands on A, exposes a missing connection, and a cross registers.
beats.before_after: Before: A is untested. After: A shows a visible route gap and fail cross.
beats.focal_detail: The broken route beneath the identical stencil.
beats.narration: Testing answer A, the stencil exposes a missing connection before its cross appears.
beats.caption: Testing answer A

beats.subject: Answer B
beats.action: The same stencil lands on B, exposes its missing connection, and a cross registers.
beats.before_after: Before: B is untested while A is already failed. After: B also shows a route gap and fail cross.
beats.focal_detail: B's broken route shown with the same stencil geometry used for A.
beats.consequence: Answer B fails; both candidates are tested and failed.
beats.narration: Testing answer B exposes another missing connection before its cross appears.
beats.caption: Testing answer B
beats.headline: A failed

beats.subject: Both failed answers
beats.action: Both marked sheets travel together into a separate person's receiving hand and remain there.
beats.before_after: Before: both failed sheets rest in the arena. After: a person holds both for review, and no winner appears.
beats.focal_detail: The receiving human hand holding both crossed answer sheets.
beats.consequence: Human review begins without an automatic selection.
beats.narration: With both tested, the assistant sends them into a person’s hand for review.
beats.caption: To a person
beats.headline: No winner
